features: user ID, item ID, brand, categories; category L2 normalization; fit catalog vocabulary only
metadata_assumption: static crawl-time snapshot; historical availability unverified
loss: mean logistic loss; observed rating>=4 positive, observed 1-3 negative, sampled unobserved negative
regularization: reg/2 times mean sum_active x_j^2*(w_j^2+||v_j||^2); feature-frequency weighted, bias unregularized
optimizer: mini-batch sparse AdaGrad, gradient summed per repeated feature before accumulator update; epsilon 1e-8
negative_sampling: uniform with replacement from fit catalog excluding ALL observed fit pairs; frozen across epochs and trials; no future exclusion
selection: maximum validation macro NDCG@10 after all 12 epochs
tie_break: fewer factors, then smaller learning rate, then larger regularization
metadata_ablation: fixed additional ID-only training run with selected hyperparameters; diagnostic only, not used for selection
